description: Create a view of a table, or change one when viewId is given. A view picks columns and filters rows, and list_table_rows can read it.

columns.description: Columns to show, in order, by title or ID

filter.description: Rows to show: all rules of an inner list must match, any one list is enough

value.description: Value, a label for selection columns

viewId.description: View to change. Omit to create one

name: save_table_view
title: Save Table View
